name: AI Search Block Log
description: Logs AI Search Block questions, answers and prompts, with visitor scoring and admin analytics.
project_description: AI Search Block Log records every AI Search Block interaction as an ai_search_block_log content entity: the visitor's question, the answer returned, the exact prompt sent to the model, a JSON detailed_output of the sources, plus a created/expiry timestamp and the acting user. Visitors can rate an answer (a thumbs score) and leave free-text feedback, posted to the /ai-search-block-log/score endpoint and stored on the log row. Admins get a logging config form (retention period) and a set of analytics dashboards under /admin/config/ai/ai_search_block_log: a graphs overview, per-day/per-block/per-user search charts, scoring statistics, and an 'AI analysis' page that asks the default chat model to summarise recurring themes in low-rated searches and feedback. A cron job deletes log rows older than the configured retention window (day/week/month/year).
